system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Age and birth asphyxia are upstream risk factors. Disease drives hemodynamic and pulmonary changes, then oxygenation/CO2 abnormalities and symptoms. Reports and imaging are downstream measurements of underlying physiology. Some nodes are closely related observables, so the order is only a plausible prior rather than a definitive causal graph.
